newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money remains at 2.85-2.95 pct.
newsitem.headline: German call money remains at 2.85-2.95 pct.

text.p: German call money rates stayed unchanged at 2.85 to 2.95 percent on Friday as banks stayed adequately furnished with liquidity, but money dealers expected liquidity to fall as pre-Christmas cash withdrawals reach a crescendo, probably on Monday.

Commercial banks' effective deposits totalled 43.1 billion marks on Thursday, down from 44.7 billion, while the average for the month through Thursday rose slightly to 40.4 billion marks from 40.2 billion.
Bank borrowing from the Bundesbank's Lombard facility totalled about 100 million marks on Thursday.
